text: Where is the lost and found office on campus? I lost my student ID card.
ai_reason: The user is asking for the location of the lost and found office, which maps to the other category. Since it is a general information query with no urgency or deadlines, the priority is low and escalation is false.
draft: If you have lost your student ID card, you can obtain a newly printed one by paying the ID card fee to the university's bank account with the description "Kart Basım Bedeli" and bringing the receipt to Student Affairs. Please remember to check the Student Affairs website before paying, as account details can change. Your question regarding the location of the lost and found office will be forwarded to the responsible office.

text: This is the third time I'm writing about my double-charged tuition and nobody answers. If it isn't fixed this week I'll contact a lawyer.
ai_reason: The student reports a double-charged tuition fee, which falls under billing and high priority. Escalation is required due to a legal threat and unanswered repeated requests.
draft: We sincerely apologize for the delay in responding to your inquiry. For extra tuition payments, you must apply with a refund petition to the official at Student Affairs' Fees Office (Harçlar Şube Müdürlüğü). Following your application, the extra amount paid will be refunded to the bank account (IBAN) in your name provided in the petition. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

text: Respectfully, I believe my Physics II midterm was graded incorrectly. Question 3 was marked wrong but my answer matches the solution key. Could someone review it?
ai_reason: The student is requesting a grade review for an exam, which belongs to academic records. Per escalation rule 5, grade and exam objections require human escalation, and the priority is medium as there is no urgent deadline mentioned.
draft: Dear student, you must submit your objection in writing to the teaching unit's management within five working days after the results are announced. Please keep in mind that exam results are only changed to correct material errors made when adding up the grades. The unit's board will make a decision regarding your objection.
